title: SM-09.17 - Email Report frequency options and delivery times
intent: This article answers: SM-09.17 - Email Report frequency options and delivery times
short_answer: Email Reports can be sent daily, weekly or monthly. Daily reports are sent between 00:00 and 07:00 and cover the previous day. Weekly reports are sent every Monday between 00:00 and 07:00 and cover the previous Monday to Sunday. Monthly reports are sent on the first day of each month and cover the previous month.
important_conditions: After selecting a frequency, EUSurvey remembers the choice.
The first daily report arrives the next day.
The first weekly report arrives the following Monday.
The first monthly report arrives on the first day of the next month.
